title: The matrix, set open
summary: The message matrix as an open page of the Narrative OS on paper at the full measure: running head with Specimen once, a one-line lead that it is filled in for Kelwin itself, large listener names, plain seller language in the cells, keys as column heads, a folio — no window, no quotes, no callouts, no slogans.

reference.site: A working messaging document (the kit's .ac-sheet anatomy, opened to the full measure)
reference.borrowed: Running head, numbered folio, column heads in the key voice, reading-size cells.
reference.kelwin: Filled in for Kelwin itself in plain working language, so it is a believable document and holds no client's work.

motion: entrance: the three listener rows rise in turn (kit cascade).
notes: Round 9 fix: the lead no longer re-describes the matrix (said once on the page); the Skeptic's proof cell no longer rewords the homepage's 'If we're not the fix' line ('Findings tied to records in their own CRM, which they can check'). It now sits between the services and 'How it runs', so the page alternates text and document.
